people.name: Gehazi
people.line: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.

translations.web: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”
translations.bsb: So he asked, “Then what should be done for her?” “Well, she has no son,” Gehazi replied, “and her husband is old.”
translations.kjv: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
translations.asv: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no son, and her husband is old.
